# forgejo_organization_avatar (Resource)

Manages the avatar for an existing Forgejo organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Base64-encoded avatar image.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization whose avatar is managed.

### Read-Only

- `hash` (String) Forgejo content identifier for the stored avatar.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier.
